. /home/probe/session-env; set -eu; date -u +%FT%T.%N; cat /proc/uptime; test ! -e /home/probe/evidence/mousekeys-round9-before-inventory.txt; pictures=$(xdg-user-dir PICTURES); test -d "$pictures"; find "$pictures" -type f -printf "%T@ %s %p\n" > /home/probe/evidence/mousekeys-round9-before-inventory.txt; printf "ROUND9_BEFORE_PRE_PRINT_COMPLETE\n"

. /home/probe/session-env; set -eu; date -u +%FT%T.%N; out=/home/probe/evidence/mousekeys-round9-before; mkdir -p "$out"; pictures=$(xdg-user-dir PICTURES); test -d "$pictures"; export CAPTURE_PICTURES="$pictures"; /usr/bin/ruby <<'RUBY'
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'base64'
baseline = '/home/probe/evidence/mousekeys-round9-before-inventory.txt'
pictures = File.realpath(ENV.fetch('CAPTURE_PICTURES'))
out = '/home/probe/evidence/mousekeys-round9-before'
seen = File.readlines(baseline, chomp: true).map do |line|
  match = /\A\S+ \d+ (.+)\z/.match(line)
  raise 'Invalid baseline inventory row' unless match
  path = match[1]
  File.exist?(path) ? File.realpath(path) : File.expand_path(path)
end
candidates = Dir.glob(File.join(pictures, '**', '*'), File::FNM_DOTMATCH).select do |path|
  File.file?(path) && !File.symlink?(path) && File.extname(path).downcase == '.png'
end.reject { |path| seen.include?(File.realpath(path)) }
raise "Expected exactly one distinct new Pictures PNG, found #{candidates.length}" unless candidates.length == 1
path = File.realpath(candidates.fetch(0))
raise 'PNG predates phase inventory' if File.mtime(path) < File.mtime(baseline)
snapshot = lambda do |file|
  s = File.stat(file)
  {'dev'=>s.dev, 'inode'=>s.ino, 'size'=>s.size,
   'mtimeSeconds'=>s.mtime.to_i, 'mtimeNs'=>s.mtime.nsec,
   'ctimeSeconds'=>s.ctime.to_i, 'ctimeNs'=>s.ctime.nsec}
end
before = snapshot.call(path)
bytes = File.binread(path)
raise 'Invalid PNG signature or IHDR' unless bytes.bytesize >= 24 && bytes.byteslice(0, 8) == "\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n".b && bytes.byteslice(12, 4) == 'IHDR'
width, height = bytes.byteslice(16, 8).unpack('N2')
raise 'Invalid PNG dimensions' unless width > 0 && height > 0
raise 'PNG changed while reading' unless snapshot.call(path) == before && bytes.bytesize == before['size']
copy = File.join(out, 'native-screen.png')
File.open(copy, File::WRONLY | File::CREAT | File::EXCL, 0600) { |io| io.write(bytes) }
digest = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(bytes)
raise 'Forensic copy hash differs' unless Digest::SHA256.file(copy).hexdigest == digest
metadata = {'originalPath'=>path, 'picturesPath'=>pictures,
 'forensicCopyPath'=>copy, 'before'=>before,
 'sha256'=>digest, 'headerHex'=>bytes.byteslice(0, 24).unpack1('H*'),
 'width'=>width, 'height'=>height,
 'baselineInventory'=>baseline, 'baselineInventoryMtime'=>File.mtime(baseline).to_r.to_s,
 'sceneTime'=>'Frozen when ScreenshotUI opened in round9 before phase; pre/post Print timestamps bound dispatch; actual UI-open completion must be established from retained Print-action image'}
File.write(File.join(out, 'native-screen-metadata.json'), JSON.pretty_generate(metadata))
puts JSON.generate(metadata)
puts 'ROUND9_BEFORE_NATIVE_PNG_BASE64_START'
puts Base64.strict_encode64(bytes)
puts 'ROUND9_BEFORE_NATIVE_PNG_BASE64_END'
after = snapshot.call(path)
raise 'Original PNG changed during transfer' unless after == before
raise 'Original PNG hash changed during transfer' unless Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest == digest
puts JSON.generate({'event'=>'after-transfer-stat', 'originalPath'=>path, 'after'=>after})
puts 'ROUND9_BEFORE_NATIVE_PNG_TRANSFER_COMPLETE'
RUBY

. /home/probe/session-env
set -eu
out=/home/probe/evidence/mousekeys-round9-calibration
test ! -e "$out"
mkdir "$out"
date -u +%FT%T.%N
cat /proc/uptime
for key in mousekeys-enable mousekeys-max-speed mousekeys-accel-time mousekeys-init-delay; do
  expected=$(cat "/home/probe/evidence/mousekeys-state-before/$key.effective")
  test "$(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard "$key")" = "$expected"
  test -z "$(dconf read "/org/gnome/desktop/a11y/keyboard/$key")"
done
test "$(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard mousekeys-enable)" = false
test "$(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard enable)" = false
export MK_CALIBRATION_OUT="$out"
cat > "$out/restore-guard.sh" <<'GUARD'
#!/bin/sh
. /home/probe/session-env
set -eu
sleep 30
date -u +%FT%T.%N
cat /proc/uptime
/usr/bin/timeout --kill-after=2 45 /usr/bin/ruby <<'RESTORE'
out = ENV.fetch('MK_CALIBRATION_OUT')
File.open(File.join(out, 'state.lock'), 'a') do |lock|
  abort "State lock failed" unless lock.flock(File::LOCK_EX)
  File.write(File.join(out, 'enable-lease-closed'), Time.now.utc.to_s)
  abort 'Guard reset failed' unless system('timeout', '--kill-after=2', '5', 'gsettings', 'reset', 'org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard', 'mousekeys-enable')
end
RESTORE
test "$(timeout --kill-after=2 5 gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard mousekeys-enable)" = false
test -z "$(timeout --kill-after=2 5 dconf read /org/gnome/desktop/a11y/keyboard/mousekeys-enable)"
test "$(timeout --kill-after=2 5 gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard enable)" = false
printf 'ROUND9_MOUSEKEYS_GUARD_COMPLETE\n'
GUARD
nohup /bin/sh "$out/restore-guard.sh" > "$out/restore-guard.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
guard=$!
printf '%s\n' "$guard" > "$out/restore-guard.pid"
kill -0 "$guard"
ps -p "$guard" -o pid,lstart,args
cat "/proc/$guard/stat"
kill -0 "$guard"
/usr/bin/timeout --kill-after=2 20 /usr/bin/ruby <<'ENABLE'
out = ENV.fetch('MK_CALIBRATION_OUT')
File.open(File.join(out, 'state.lock'), 'a') do |lock|
  abort "State lock failed" unless lock.flock(File::LOCK_EX)
  abort 'Enable lease already closed' if File.exist?(File.join(out, 'enable-lease-closed'))
  completed = false
  begin
    abort 'Mouse Keys enable failed' unless system('timeout', '--kill-after=2', '5', 'gsettings', 'set', 'org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard', 'mousekeys-enable', 'true')
    value = IO.popen(['timeout', '--kill-after=2', '5', 'gsettings', 'get', 'org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard', 'mousekeys-enable'], &:read)
    abort 'Mouse Keys readback failed' unless $?.success? && value.strip == 'true'
    File.write(File.join(out, 'activation-receipt'), Time.now.utc.to_s)
    completed = true
  ensure
    unless completed
      system('timeout', '--kill-after=2', '5', 'gsettings', 'reset', 'org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard', 'mousekeys-enable')
    end
  end
end
ENABLE
printf 'ROUND9_MOUSEKEYS_ENABLE_COMPLETE\n'

. /home/probe/session-env
set -eu
out=/home/probe/evidence/mousekeys-round9-calibration
date -u +%FT%T.%N
cat /proc/uptime
gsettings reset org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard mousekeys-enable
test "$(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard mousekeys-enable)" = false
test -z "$(dconf read /org/gnome/desktop/a11y/keyboard/mousekeys-enable)"
test "$(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard enable)" = false
completed=0
for attempt in $(seq 1 25); do
  if grep -q '^ROUND9_MOUSEKEYS_GUARD_COMPLETE$' "$out/restore-guard.log"; then
    completed=1
    break
  fi
  sleep 2
done
cat "$out/restore-guard.log"
test "$completed" = 1
for key in mousekeys-enable mousekeys-max-speed mousekeys-accel-time mousekeys-init-delay; do
  expected=$(cat "/home/probe/evidence/mousekeys-state-before/$key.effective")
  actual=$(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard "$key")
  printf 'RESTORED_KEY=%s EXPECTED=%s ACTUAL=%s\n' "$key" "$expected" "$actual"
  test "$actual" = "$expected"
  test -z "$(dconf read "/org/gnome/desktop/a11y/keyboard/$key")"
done
printf 'ROUND9_MOUSEKEYS_RESTORE_COMPLETE\n'
